boxes.title: [...document.querySelectorAll('h1,h2,h3,p,div,span')].find(e => e.children.length === 0 && e.textContent.trim() === 'Get started with QSME')
boxes.hireCard: (() => { let e = [...document.querySelectorAll('h1,h2,h3,p,div,span')].find(e => e.children.length === 0 && e.textContent.trim() === 'I hire'); for (let i = 0; i < 6 && e; i++) { e = e.parentElement; if (e && e.textContent.includes('Main contractors') && e.textContent.length < 400) return e; } return null; })()
boxes.review: (() => { const p = [...document.querySelectorAll('p,div,span')].find(e => e.children.length === 0 && e.textContent.includes('review proposals')); if (!p) return null; const r = document.createRange(); const n = p.firstChild; const i = n.textContent.indexOf('review proposals'); r.setStart(n, i); r.setEnd(n, i + 'review proposals'.length); return r; })()
